correctness.rationale: Exact moment computation gives kernel K=1+x·y/q. Convexity and rotational symmetry localize the absolute kernel maximum at |x|=1; the sign datum attains it. Symmetric kernel yields equal L1 and L∞ norms. Slicing annular negative caps gives the sharp formula, differentiating q shows monotone r-q and unique contact, and the explicit small-cap beta integral yields the positive coefficient of (r-r_d)_+^((d+3)/2), establishing sharp regularity in all dimensions. Planar primitive and root follow by direct integration. Executed 205 quadrature/identity checks and 8 independent high-precision scaling checks, with all passing; computations are supplementary, not universal proofs.
